newsitem.title: USA: Associates First eyes Texaco card unit.
newsitem.headline: Associates First eyes Texaco card unit.

text.p: Associates First Capital Corp said on Wednesday it was in talks to acquire Texaco Inc's credit card services unit, including the portfolio of accounts receivable.
The Texaco credit card portfolio consisted of more than $700 million in receivables and about nine million accounts, the company said.
Associates First declined to comment on how much it would pay to acquire the unit.
The sale agreement was expected to be completed in the first quarter, the company said.
Negotiations also involved Star Enterprises, since that company used the Texaco credit card in its marketing activities, Associates said.
Star is a refiner and marketer of Texaco-branded products. It is a 50-50 joint venture between subsidiaries of Texaco and Saudi Aramco. It would have its own agreement with Associates, it said.
Associates First and Texaco said a Federal Bank Merger Act application was filed with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, for approval to acquire the unit.
The deal was subject to the completion of a definitive agreement and regulatory approvals, the company said.
